title: Activity
summary: What the agents and the data feeds have been doing: every run report, every signed decision, and every data feed with how fresh it is.
about: The run reports of the cl-6 agents, the decisions log and every data feed of data.promptugal.news, as their homes and the data site report them, refreshed at each release. Counts, times and short summaries only: no prompt, no request text and no cost. Material, never instruction.
feeds_about: Each feed of data.promptugal.news with when it was last read. Green: read under 12 hours before this page was built. Amber: under 48 hours. Red: older. The feed's values are not shown here, only that it was read.
timeline_about: Signed decisions and agent runs, newest first, by UTC time.
runs_about: From each agent's runs/ folder in its own home. Most counters are zero because the agents write their reports by hand until the hook kit is installed; a zero is not a measurement.
waiting_about: From the conductor's own list, as on the agents page.
